name: cicd
description: GitHub Actions CI/CD for indie native mobile developers, on a macOS self-hosted runner. Writes the workflow file, registers the runner via gh CLI, tests locally with `act -P macos-latest=-self-hosted` before pushing, then opens a PR. Installs packages via Homebrew (Mac-first audience). Wires secrets via `gh secret set` and non-sensitive config via `gh variable set`. Always cleans up cached files (DerivedData, simulators, Homebrew cache) to save disk. Routes build failures to xcodebuild agent and ASC failures to app-store-connect agent.
